title: Success & Failure Idioms
completion_message: ¡Excelente! El inglés de negocios está lleno de coloridas metáforas de deportes y aviación. Conocer estas expresiones te hará sonar natural y seguro en el 'C-suite'.

parts.visual:
Los ejecutivos angloparlantes adoran las metáforas de deportes y guerra. 

ÉXITO: 
1. Hit it out of the park (Sacarla del estadio / Éxito rotundo): 
Ej: The new marketing team really HIT IT OUT OF THE PARK with this campaign. 

2. Pass with flying colors (Aprobar/Pasar con gran éxito): 
Ej: The software PASSED the security audit WITH FLYING COLORS. 

3. Ahead of the curve (A la vanguardia / Adelantado a su tiempo): 
Ej: Apple was AHEAD OF THE CURVE with the iPhone.
parts.audio: Welcome to Success and Failure Idioms. English-speaking executives love using metaphors from sports and the military. Let's start with success. Number 1: Hit it out of the park. This comes from baseball, meaning a massive success. For example: The new marketing team really HIT IT OUT OF THE PARK with this campaign. Number 2: Pass with flying colors. To succeed easily and impressively. For example: The software PASSED the security audit WITH FLYING COLORS. Number 3: Ahead of the curve. To be more advanced or modern than others. For example: Apple was AHEAD OF THE CURVE with the iPhone.

parts.visual:
FRACASO Y RECUPERACIÓN: 

4. Go down in flames (Fracasar estrepitosamente): 
Ej: The startup WENT DOWN IN FLAMES after the CEO was arrested. 

5. A recipe for disaster (Una receta para el desastre): 
Ej: Expanding to Asia without a plan is A RECIPE FOR DISASTER. 

6. Back to the drawing board (Volver a la mesa de dibujo / Empezar de cero): 
Ej: The prototype failed the test, so it's BACK TO THE DRAWING BOARD. 

7. Cut our losses (Cortar las pérdidas / Retirarse antes de perder más): 
Ej: The project is bleeding money; we need to CUT OUR LOSSES and cancel it.
parts.audio: Now, idioms for failure and recovery. Number 4: Go down in flames. To fail spectacularly and publicly. For example: The startup WENT DOWN IN FLAMES after the CEO was arrested. Number 5: A recipe for disaster. A plan or situation that is guaranteed to fail. For example: Expanding to Asia without a plan is A RECIPE FOR DISASTER. Number 6: Back to the drawing board. Meaning we have to start all over again because the current plan failed. For example: The prototype failed the test, so it's BACK TO THE DRAWING BOARD. Number 7: Cut our losses. To abandon a failing project before you lose even more money. For example: The project is bleeding money; we need to CUT OUR LOSSES and cancel it.

questions.question: The presentation was brilliant! You really hit it out of the ____. (La sacaste del estadio).
questions.explanation: Hit it out of the park = tener un éxito inmenso (béisbol).

questions.question: She is brilliant and always anticipates market trends; she is always ahead of the ____.
questions.explanation: Ahead of the curve = a la vanguardia, un paso adelante.

questions.question: Don't worry about the inspection. I'm sure our factory will pass with ____ colors.
questions.explanation: Pass with flying colors = pasar con honores/excelente nota.

questions.question: The merger was a complete failure. The whole deal went down in ____. (Fracasó estrepitosamente).
questions.explanation: Go down in flames = fracasar espectacularmente.

questions.question: Putting an inexperienced manager in charge of our biggest account is a recipe for ____.
questions.explanation: A recipe for disaster = una receta para el desastre.

questions.question: The client rejected all our designs. I guess it's back to the ____ board. (Volver a empezar).
questions.explanation: Back to the drawing board = volver a la mesa de dibujo (empezar de cero).

questions.question: We have already lost a million dollars on this software. It's time to ____ our losses and abandon it.
questions.explanation: Cut our losses = cortar las pérdidas (retirarse a tiempo).

questions.question: To start a project strongly and successfully is to hit the ground ____. (Empezar a toda marcha).
questions.explanation: Hit the ground running = empezar un proyecto o trabajo con mucha energía y sin demoras.

questions.question: We achieved a huge milestone today. It's a major feather in our ____. (Un gran logro en nuestro historial).
questions.explanation: A feather in your cap = un gran logro del que puedes estar orgulloso.

questions.question: Despite the crisis, the company managed to weather the ____ and stay profitable. (Superar la tormenta).
questions.explanation: Weather the storm = sobrevivir a una situación difícil.

questions.question: We are totally bankrupt. Our business has gone belly ____. (Ir a la quiebra).
questions.explanation: Go belly up = quebrar (como un pez muerto flotando).

questions.question: The new product was completely ignored by the public. It fell ____. (Fracasó, no tuvo impacto).
questions.explanation: Fall flat = no tener el efecto o éxito deseado.

questions.question: We finally got the green ____ to start the construction project. (Luz verde/Autorización).
questions.explanation: Get the green light = recibir autorización.

questions.question: They were doing great, but then they dropped the ____ on the final delivery. (Cometieron un error grave).
questions.explanation: Drop the ball = cometer un error por descuido (dejar caer la pelota).

questions.question: His strategy was completely wrong. He missed the ____ entirely. (No entendió/Falló el objetivo).
questions.explanation: Miss the mark = no dar en el blanco, fracasar en el objetivo.

questions.question: The boss is furious because we blew our ____ to sign the biggest client of the year. (Desperdiciar una oportunidad).
questions.explanation: Blow a chance/opportunity = desperdiciar o arruinar una oportunidad.

questions.question: It's time to face the ____. The company is broke and we have to close. (Afrontar la dura realidad).
questions.explanation: Face the music = afrontar las consecuencias negativas de algo.

questions.question: By firing the CEO, they managed to pull the company back from the ____. (Salvarla del abismo).
questions.explanation: Pull back from the brink = salvar algo justo antes del desastre total.

questions.question: If we don't modernize our technology, we will be left in the ____ by our competitors. (Dejados atrás).
questions.explanation: Leave in the dust = dejar atrás (morder el polvo).

questions.question: This victory is just the tip of the ____. We are going to dominate the market. (Punta del iceberg).
questions.explanation: The tip of the iceberg = la punta del iceberg.
